lessons.title: Names, values, and output
lessons.intro: Read statements from top to bottom. A name refers to its current value; assignment with = binds or rebinds it. Quoted text is a string, while an unquoted name looks up a value. print(...) displays values; multiple arguments are separated by spaces. Text after # is a comment, not an instruction.

lessons.title: Exceptions and resource cleanup
lessons.intro: try encloses work that may fail; except handles matching exceptions. An exception skips the remaining statements in the try block. finally runs during normal exit or exception propagation. A with block delegates cleanup to a context manager; with open(...) closes the file when leaving the block. Catch the exception you expect rather than hiding every error. ValueError(message) constructs an exception object; raising it is a separate action. ValueError(message) constructs an exception object; raising it is a separate action.
